meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 安装后，AI 助手能接入 GitHub 频道，作为机器人账号参与 PR 和 issue 的评论线程。当被 @提及 时回复，并订阅该线程以回应后续所有评论。
howto.when: 当 GitHub 仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论中出现 @机器人用户名 时触发；首次被 @后，该讨论串的后续评论都会触发回应。

say.text: @my-org-bot 请总结这个 PR 的变更内容。
say.note: 机器人会回复评论线程。

say.text: @my-org-bot 你觉得这个 issue 的解决方案可行吗？
say.note: 机器人将在该 issue 下回复。

say.text: @my-org-bot 回复一下第 3 条评论，说明你的看法。
say.note: 机器人会在对应评论下给出回应。

howto.what_en: After installation, the AI assistant can connect to GitHub channel and participate in PR and issue comment threads as a bot account. It replies when @-mentioned and subscribes to the thread for follow-up comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a PR or issue comment contains @bot-username; after the first mention, all subsequent comments in the thread trigger responses.

say_en.text: @my-org-bot Please summarize the changes in this PR.
say_en.note: Bot will reply in the comment thread.

say_en.text: @my-org-bot Do you think the solution in this issue works?
say_en.note: Bot will reply in the issue.

say_en.text: @my-org-bot Reply to comment #3 with your view.
say_en.note: Bot will respond under that comment.
